method: Individually inspected Wikimedia Commons file-description pages for file title, subject description, named credited creator and licence. This is source-metadata verification, not independent visual/pixel or offline-binary validation.
displayRequirements: Before production use, independently inspect displayed pixels and current file metadata; visibly credit named author, link the exact Commons file page and licence, indicate any edits/crops, and comply with ShareAlike when applicable.
